name: Graveborn the Elder
summary: During the Lunar Festival, Graveborn the Elder waits outside Brill in Tirisfal Glades. Travelers find him among its blighted groves to honor Azeroth’s ancient forebears and receive his blessing and a holiday token.

sections.title: A Ghostly Vigil in Brill
sections.body: In Tirisfal Glades, the Forsaken make their homes among ruined manors and grave sites. During the Lunar Festival, an ancient spirit appears just outside Brill. Elder Graveborn welcomes pilgrims who pause to honor the old ways, even in a land shattered by the Scourge and reclaimed by the undead.

sections.title: Honoring the Olden Races
sections.body: During the Lunar Festival, spirits from long ago return with wisdom and gratitude. When you approach Elder Graveborn, he says it heartens him that Tirisfal’s people still honor their ancestors despite the land’s decay. He gives you a Coin of Ancestry when you greet him.

faq.answer: Elder Graveborn waits beside the road outside Brill in Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: What happens when you speak to Elder Graveborn?
faq.answer: When you greet Elder Graveborn, he praises you for honoring Azeroth’s ancient peoples and gives you a Coin of Ancestry for the Lunar Festival.

faq.q: Why is an ancient elder standing in Tirisfal Glades?
faq.answer: During the Lunar Festival, ancestral spirits appear across Azeroth, from kaldorei forests to lands scarred by war and plague. Elder Graveborn watches over northern Lordaeron, where death threatens to eclipse the region’s history.

faq.q: Can Alliance players visit Elder Graveborn?
faq.answer: Elder Graveborn is a neutral spirit who speaks with Alliance and Horde members alike. Since he waits just outside the Forsaken town of Brill, Alliance adventurers must beware the local guards.

faq.q: What is the Coin of Ancestry used for?
faq.answer: During the Lunar Festival, you can trade Coins of Ancestry gathered from elders like Graveborn in Moonglade for festive garments, firework recipes, and other celebratory tokens.

faq.q: Is Elder Graveborn one of the Forsaken?
faq.answer: No. Elder Graveborn is an ancient spirit honored during the Lunar Festival, not one of the Forsaken. His ghostly form and name near Brill belong to Azeroth’s lineage of elders, not Sylvanas’s Forsaken.

angles.text: As Forsaken living in Brill, you see ancient ancestral spirits arrive as a reminder of Azeroth’s deeper history beyond the Scourge’s recent tragedies.
As an Alliance adventurer, you must tread carefully through Tirisfal Glades to find Elder Graveborn, since Brill is a heavily fortified Forsaken haven.
As a druid, you revere the Lunar Festival elders as links to the ancient world before the Sundering, beyond the faction boundaries around them.
